info.title: NGM — Nginx Gateway Manager API
info.description: Versioned control-plane API. See API_CONTRACT.md for conventions (errors, ETag/If-Match, Idempotency-Key, pagination, SSE).

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag of the current revision, e.g. "r3"

get.summary: Aggregate health. Anonymous callers receive status only; component detail requires system.read.
Server-Sent Events stream with Last-Event-ID replay, resync on gaps, 15s heartbeat, scope-filtered.
First-run wizard progress. Public; preflight details only with system.read.

post.summary: Create the first Owner. Direct loopback (local/SSH tunnel) only; requires the installer bootstrap token; only while no user exists.

200.description: Session cookies set; MFA still required

post.summary: Create a pending TOTP secret (mfa_enroll stage only).

get.summary: Secret metadata only. Values are never returned (no read-back).

201.description: Created (desired state only; deploy to apply)
Created (desired state only; deploy to apply)
Created (desired state only; deploy to apply)
Created (desired state only; deploy to apply)

post.summary: Import PEM chain + key. The key is stored in the vault and never returned.

get.summary: Validate the desired model; with preview=1 also return the generated read-only Nginx configuration (secrets redacted).

post.summary: Route Simulation Lab: evaluate a hypothetical connection against the compiled desired or active model. Models compiled configuration only.

get.summary: Latest active health-check evidence per endpoint; stale evidence is reported as unknown.
Desired NGM-owned UFW rules and the latest observed UFW state (foreign rules listed, never modified).

204.description: Marked for removal on next apply

post.summary: Apply desired rules (and optionally enable UFW). Risky changes arm a dead-man watchdog and wait for /firewall/confirm.
Queue an encrypted local backup (409 no_passphrase until a passphrase is set).

200.description: Passphrase state, schedule and local-storage warning
Derived archive key stored in the vault; the passphrase itself is never stored
Archive decrypts, hashes match, database passes integrity_check
Incident with job and journaled steps

post.summary: Supervised resolution: the operator attests the outcome after manual checks (step-up MFA).
Supervised reconcile of record/data-plane drift: adopt the serving generation or restore the recorded one; verified by probes, closes the incident on success.

200.description: Drift between NGM's record and the served generation (null when consistent)
Registered domains with DNS evidence status (ok | attention | unknown)
Domain, expectations, observations (authoritative and resolver), comparison and usage

delete.summary: Refused with 409 while routes, certificates or the management origin use the domain.

202.description: Check requested; ngm-monitor performs the DNS lookups

post.summary: Order a certificate through ACME HTTP-01 (Let's Encrypt staging or production). Requires a deployed HTTP listener on port 80; wildcards are refused (DNS-01 not implemented).
Renew an ACME certificate now (also automatic 30 days before expiry). The renewed certificate is deployed by a Safe Apply if routes use it.

200.description: Whether a token is configured (never returned)

post.summary: Queue a read-only plan (creates/updates/conflicts; external records untouched).
Apply exactly the previewed plan (plan_hash); conflicts change only if adopted explicitly.

201.description: Created (template sites start from starter content)

200.description: Website, draft content, validation errors/warnings, routes using it

delete.summary: Queue removal of published files and the record (409 while routes serve it).

200.description: Saved draft with validation errors and warnings

201.description: Archive stored; validated by the build job

post.summary: Publish (or roll back to) a built version: copy, atomic per-site pointer switch, verification through Nginx, compensating rollback.

200.description: Signed preview URL valid for 30 minutes
Built file served with Content-Security-Policy: sandbox (opaque origin)

get.summary: Public but authorised by the expiring signed token in the path.

200.description: Indexer status (lag per source, pause reason) and retention
Latest sample with freshness and bounded history
Saved; applied with the next deployment
Typed graph (bounded to 2000 nodes) with observed status

get.summary: Installed releases and the last update attempt (read-only; installing is a root CLI action)
Fallback website served to unmatched hosts/SNI (ADR-036)

put.summary: Set or clear the fallback website (applies with the next deployment)
